description: This file defines API routes for order-related operations using FastAPI, including checkout, listing orders, and retrieving specific order details. It utilizes dependency injection for database sessions and authentication, and interacts with the OrderService for business logic.

methods.name: list_my_orders(db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of orders belonging to the current user.

methods.name: get_my_order(order_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific order for the current user by order ID.
